title: Package Delivery — office building navigation (the Hindsight exemplar)

tools.name: whereami
tools.description: Where you are right now: location, floor, moves used so far, and which package you are carrying.

tools.name: look
tools.description: Look around your current location: what's here and which adjacent locations you can move to.

tools.name: read_directory
tools.description: Read the building directory. Only works when you are at the lobby directory desk; lists which office each employee is in.

tools.name: check_office
tools.description: Read the nameplate at the office you are currently standing at (who works here).

tools.name: accept_package
tools.description: Pick up a package to deliver to a named recipient. Starts a fresh delivery trip at the lobby.

tools.name: move
tools.description: Walk to an adjacent location (must be one of your current exits). Counts as one move.

tools.name: take_elevator
tools.description: Take the elevator to a floor. Only works when you are at an elevator landing. Counts as one move.

tools.name: deliver
tools.description: Hand the package to the recipient. Returns the graded outcome (you must be at the recipient's office).
